# Acceptance Criteria Traceability Matrix

| AC | Requirement / behavior to prove | Smallest valid test layer | Test file(s) / check(s) | Negative / edge case | Evidence command | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC1 | <statement> | unit | <path> | <edge case> | <command> | planned |
| AC2 | <statement> | integration | <path> | <negative case> | <command> | planned |

## Notes
- Prefer the smallest layer that proves the behavior.
- Avoid creating a second testing style when an existing convention already exists.
- Convert “planned” to `covered`, `blocked`, or `not_applicable` before handoff.
